company.name: Ophelia
company.shortDescription: Ophelia offers medication and support for quitting opioids.
company.description:
Ophelia offers medication and support for quitting opioids. They are a diverse collection of hearts and minds - doctors, scientists, techies, and citizens - on a mission to offer the best of medicine without the baggage of rehab. They are driven by science, committed to privacy, and bound to the client's right to make their own choices. They believe in recommendations, not orders.

It was founded in 2019 and is based in New York, New York.

productsAndServices.description: A telehealth service providing medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder, including Suboxone prescriptions and clinical support via video visits.
productsAndServices.name: Online Opioid Addiction Treatment

productsAndServices.description: Prescription and management of Suboxone (buprenorphine + naloxone) to reduce opioid cravings and withdrawal symptoms as part of opioid use disorder treatment.
productsAndServices.name: Medication Management with Suboxone

productsAndServices.description: Ongoing clinical support from a multidisciplinary team including clinicians, nurses, care coordinators, and peers, accessible seven days a week via phone, text, or email.
productsAndServices.name: Clinical Support and Care Coordination

productsAndServices.description: Remote urine drug testing conducted via mailed kits and supervised through video calls to monitor treatment adherence and substance use.
productsAndServices.name: At-Home Drug Testing

productsAndServices.description: Assistance with insurance verification, coverage for medication-assisted treatment, and transparent pricing for uninsured patients.
productsAndServices.name: Insurance and Payment Support

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,027,682 to $315,885,165, a 24.25x increase.
